# Tangle Docs

> Tangle Docs explain how to run coding agents in Tangle Sandbox, call models through Tangle Router, and use one Tangle account, key and balance for both.

## Start here

- [Docs home](https://docs.tangle.tools/): every Tangle product documented on this site.
- [Sandbox overview](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/overview): what Tangle Sandbox is and how to drive it from TypeScript, Python, the CLI or REST.
- [Sandbox quickstart](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/quickstart): create a sandbox, run a command, prompt a coding agent and delete the sandbox.
- [Router](https://docs.tangle.tools/gateway): one API for supported models, with provider and Tangle operator routes.
- [Router quickstart](https://docs.tangle.tools/gateway/getting-started): your first Router call.
- [Platform](https://docs.tangle.tools/platform): one Tangle account, API key and balance behind every product.
- [Release notes](https://docs.tangle.tools/release-notes): dated release notes for each product line.
- [Benchmarks](https://tangle.tools/benchmarks): measured sandbox and coding-agent times.

## Sandbox: get started

- [Overview](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/overview): what a sandbox gives your code and coding agents, and the ways to drive one.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/quickstart): your first sandbox and coding-agent prompt in TypeScript, Python or the CLI.
- [API keys and tokens](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/authentication): create and rotate API keys, sign the CLI in, and give browsers scoped tokens.
- [Teams](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/teams): share sandboxes, secrets and templates with a team.
- [How sandboxes work](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/concepts): sandbox states, what survives a stop, the coding agent inside, network and ownership rules.

## Sandbox: sandboxes

- [Create, stop and delete](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/lifecycle): every create option, timer, stop, resume and delete.
- [Run commands and code](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/commands): exec, background processes and persistent code kernels.
- [Stream output](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/streaming): stream command and coding-agent output as it happens.
- [Files](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/files): read, write, upload and download files.
- [Git](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/git): clone on create, then status, commit, push and pull inside the sandbox.
- [Ports and preview links](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/ports-previews): give a port in the sandbox a public URL.
- [Shells and terminals](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/terminals): interactive terminals and SSH into a sandbox.
- [Snapshots and forks](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/snapshots): save a sandbox's workspace and start new sandboxes from it.
- [Templates and images](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/templates-gallery): start sandboxes from environments, templates and container images.
- [Startup scripts](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/startup-scripts): run your own setup each time a sandbox starts.
- [GPU leases](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/gpu-leases): attach a GPU to a sandbox for a set time and spend cap.
- [Traces and resource usage](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/observability): read traces and CPU, memory and disk use.

## Sandbox: network, secrets and security

- [Network access](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/egress): open, strict and blocked outbound network policies.
- [Secrets](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/secrets): store secrets once and inject them into sandboxes.
- [Credentials and the egress proxy](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/credentials-and-egress): proxy custody keeps a credential out of the agent; a threat model and a measured boundary test.
- [Isolation and compliance](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/security): the sandbox security boundary and HIPAA placement.
- [Sandbox compliance pinning](https://docs.tangle.tools/gateway/hipaa/sandbox-pinning): how HIPAA-pinned sandboxes are placed and which calls refuse them.

## Sandbox: coding agents

- [Run a coding agent](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cloud-agents): start Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or another coding agent on a repository.
- [Interactive mode](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/interactive): drive a coding agent's own terminal UI from your terminal or a browser.
- [Sessions](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sessions): continue a coding agent's conversation across calls and processes.
- [Claude Code on your Claude plan](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cloud-agents-claude-code): run Claude Code on your Claude subscription.
- [Codex on your ChatGPT plan](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cloud-agents-codex): run Codex signed in with your ChatGPT plan or OpenAI key.
- [GLM, Kimi and MiniMax plans](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cloud-agents-coding-plans): run OpenCode against a coding plan you already pay for.
- [AgentProfiles](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cloud-agents-profiles): describe an agent once and run it on any coding agent.
- [Where an agent runs](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/run-targets): run one profile in a sandbox, as a worker under a supervisor, or through inference routing alone.
- [Connections](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/connections): grant a coding agent actions on accounts such as GitHub or Gmail.
- [Several agents in one sandbox](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-multiple): run a planner, an implementer and a reviewer side by side.
- [One sandbox per user](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/instances): keep one sandbox per customer that is created or resumed on demand.
- [Email, iMessage and voice lines](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/lines): reach a sandbox agent by email, message or phone.

## Sandbox: scale out

- [Fleets](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-fleet): run work across many sandboxes under one spend budget.
- [Batches and hosted runs](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/runs-and-batch): run a queue of tasks in one call, or let the platform place an AgentProfile run.
- [Agent graphs](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-graphs): connect agents into a graph of roles and routes.

## Sandbox: agent frameworks

- [Integrations](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/integrations): every framework, MCP client and sandbox cloud Tangle Sandbox works with.
- [Anthropic SDK](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-anthropic): give Claude sandbox tools in your own Messages API loop.
- [OpenAI](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-openai): give an OpenAI or Router model sandbox tools in Chat Completions.
- [Vercel AI SDK](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-vercel-ai): add sandbox tools to generateText or streamText.
- [Mastra](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-mastra): give a Mastra agent sandbox tools.
- [MCP clients](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agents-mcp): connect Claude Desktop, Cursor or any MCP client to a sandbox.

## Sandbox: agent runtime and evaluation

- [Run agents with agent-runtime](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/agent-runtime): supervise coding agents in their own sandboxes under one budget.
- [Run on E2B, Daytona and more](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/other-providers): run one AgentProfile on several sandbox clouds.
- [Evaluate agents](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/evaluation): score sandbox agents on fixed cases and compare models.

## Sandbox: workflows

- [Workflows](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/workflows): define multi-step jobs that run in sandboxes.
- [Run and inspect workflows](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/workflows-run): start a workflow and read its state.
- [Workflow YAML](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/workflows-yaml): the workflow file format.
- [Workflow templates](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/workflows-templates): start from a ready-made workflow.

## Sandbox: examples

- [Examples](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/examples): complete programs, grouped by task.
- [Sandbox examples](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/examples/sandboxes): commands, files, ports and snapshots.
- [Coding agent examples](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/examples/coding-agents): Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode fixing tests and committing.
- [Product examples](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/examples/products): sandbox agents behind a product, one sandbox per customer.
- [Fleet examples](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/examples/fleets): fan work out across many sandboxes under a budget.
- [Evaluation and other clouds](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/examples/evals-and-runtime): evaluation runs and other sandbox providers.
- [Python examples](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/examples/python): the same tasks with the Python SDK.
- [CLI examples](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/examples/cli): command sequences for the tangle CLI.

## Sandbox: reference

- [Glossary](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/glossary): the Tangle agent terms defined, each linking to the page that owns it.
- [TypeScript SDK](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-typescript): install @tangle-network/sandbox and use the client.
- [TypeScript client](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-typescript/client): the Sandbox client class and its options.
- [TypeScript sandbox instance](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-typescript/sandbox): lifecycle methods on a sandbox.
- [TypeScript commands, files and ports](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-typescript/runtime): exec, process, files, git and preview links.
- [TypeScript agents and sessions](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-typescript/agents): prompt, stream and session methods.
- [TypeScript secrets, templates and fleets](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-typescript/resources): account-level resources.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-python): install tangle-sandbox and use the sync and async clients.
- [Python Sandbox and AsyncSandbox](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-python/client): the Python client classes.
- [Python SandboxInstance](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-python/instance): lifecycle, exec, files, prompts and git on one sandbox.
- [Python fleets and optional modules](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-python/fleets-and-extras): fleets, agent tools and trace export.
- [Python types and errors](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/sdk-python/types-and-errors): every option and result type, and SandboxError.
- [CLI](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cli): install the tangle CLI, log in and script it.
- [CLI sandbox commands](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cli/sandboxes): tangle sandbox, exec, ssh, snapshot, branch and usage.
- [CLI file, git and process commands](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cli/workspace): tangle fs, git, process and preview.
- [CLI agent, fleet and batch commands](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cli/agents): run coding agents from the terminal.
- [CLI account and team commands](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cli/account): keys, secrets, teams and templates.
- [CLI workflow commands](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cli/workflows): validate, deploy, run and inspect workflows.
- [CLI hub and line commands](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cli/hub-and-lines): connect accounts and attach lines to agents.
- [CLI intelligence and trace commands](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cli/intelligence): reports and agent traces.
- [REST API](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/api-reference): base URL, authentication, a first request and the route groups.
- [Sandboxes and GPU routes](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/api-reference/sandboxes): create, stop, snapshot, branch and delete sandboxes over HTTP.
- [In-sandbox runtime routes](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/api-reference/runtime): commands, files, git, terminals and agent runs inside one sandbox.
- [Sessions and backends routes](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/api-reference/sessions): coding-agent sessions, plans, backends and models.
- [Fleets, templates and teams routes](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/api-reference/resources): fleets, templates, secrets, SSH keys and teams.
- [Account, usage and pricing routes](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/api-reference/account): account, usage, billing and public prices.
- [E2B-compatible routes](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/api-reference/e2b): E2B's REST shape under /e2b with a Tangle key.
- [OpenAPI document](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox-openapi.json): the full Sandbox API as OpenAPI 3 JSON.

## Sandbox: operate

- [Pricing and spend](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/cost): what a sandbox bills for, where to read prices and how to cap spend.
- [Limits and timeouts](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/limits): account limits, the API rate limit and fixed size and time limits.
- [Error codes](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/errors): every error code with its status, whether to retry and the fix.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/troubleshooting): fixes for common problems, by symptom.
- [Dashboard](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/web-app): a tour of the dashboard at sandbox.tangle.tools.
- [Sandbox release notes](https://docs.tangle.tools/release-notes/sandbox): dated changes to Tangle Sandbox.

## Sandbox: compare and migrate

- [Compare sandboxes](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/comparison): Tangle Sandbox beside E2B, Daytona, Modal, Vercel, Cloudflare and Runloop.
- [Move from E2B](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/migrate-e2b): map E2B calls to Tangle and use the E2B-compatible routes.
- [Move from Daytona](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/migrate-daytona): map Daytona calls and settings to Tangle.
- [Move from Modal](https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox/migrate-modal): map Modal Sandbox calls to Tangle.

## Agent guidance

- Set up Tangle Sandbox with the product's setup skill: https://sandbox.tangle.tools/agent-setup.md.
- Use the docs setup skill at https://docs.tangle.tools/agent-setup.md.
- Use the Tangle product manifest at https://tangle.tools/.well-known/tangle-agent.json.
- Use the Sandbox OpenAPI document at https://docs.tangle.tools/sandbox-openapi.json and the Router OpenAPI document at https://router.tangle.tools/openapi.json.
- Install scoped packages only: `@tangle-network/sandbox`, `@tangle-network/sandbox-cli` and `@tangle-network/tcloud` from npm, and `tangle-sandbox` from PyPI.
- Send `TANGLE_API_KEY` as a bearer token, and pass `https://sandbox.tangle.tools` as the Sandbox base URL.
